note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every until and expect is derived by hand from the 22-wire topology and the p.5 rule, not printed; the printed fixture C2/V-EXP4 covers the turning and each lamp coming on and going off, direction-free. No erratum touches Book V Experiment 4, so wires = as_printed (image-checked on PDF p.11). Topology: lamp 4 on D11-D15 and D0 (6 pads), lamp 5 on D7-D10 (4 pads), lamp 6 on D1-D6 (6 pads), wiper D16 on M-; RUN is D17 on M-, D18 on M+, the reverse of O-R11's increasing sense (D17 +, D18 -; Tom's ruling 2026-10-13, [likely]), so the dial turns toward decreasing numbers and the lamp order is 4, 5, 6, 4 (red, amber, green, red), as p.5 'turning lights 4, 5 and 6 on and off in succession' lists them. p.4 = PDF p.10 'follows a pre-programmed cycle from red to green to yellow and back to red' gives 4, 6, 5 and conflicts; this fixture follows the wiring under O-R11, so it fails if O-R11 is reversed. Checkpoints: lamp 4 at c14 within 600 ms of power-on (direction; the window passes for run rates above about 15 rpm and rejects the reverse below about 85 rpm, against the 45 rpm assumption, O-R3); lamp 5 alone at c8, lamp 6 alone at c3, lamp 4 alone at c13 on the next pass; then the knob held by hand (dialGrab, 1500 ms per hold, a script choice) on each block-edge pad c11, c10, c7, c6, c1, c0 to show the 6, 4, 6 pad dwell with the lamps settled; then release and the motor resumes decreasing to c14. Motor-run checks sit on interior pads so no lamp is asserted within one pitch of being driven or cut. Not asserted: lamps in a gap (break-before-make, filament lag), the outgoing lamp's state at the first pad of the next block, the colour names, and 'The length of time any given light remains on may be varied by changing the connections on the rotary switch' (needs an unprinted rewiring). Assumptions: a lamp undriven for three pitches or more reads off and a lamp on its pad reads on within that pad's dwell; the power-on rest is c0 (no printed start position); rotary geometry, run rate and coast are profile fallbacks O-R1, O-R3, O-R5.
